raw_text: This Fauji Times robot soldier article is going viral without the satire disclaimer. I've already seen three WhatsApp groups sharing it as real news. People need to check their sources. The article literally mentions 'chai dispensers' and 'RTI responses in 30 seconds.' How is anyone taking this seriously? Classic April Fools bait.
clean_text: Reddit user notes Fauji Times satire about robot soldiers going viral without disclaimer. Being shared as real news on WhatsApp. April Fools content taken seriously.
